name: Wretched Tide, Swarm of Dretches

alignment.name: Chaotic Evil
alignment.description:
Chaotic evil creatures have a complete disregard for others. They kill, steal, and betray others to gain power. Their word is meaningless and their actions destructive. Their worldviews can be so warped that they destroy anything and anyone that doesn’t directly contribute to their interests.
	By the standards of good and lawful good people, chaotic evil is as abhorrent as evil, perhaps even more so. Chaotic evil monsters such as demons and orcs are at least as much of a threat to civilization and general well-being as evil monsters are. An evil creature and a chaotic evil creature are both opposed to good, but they don’t have much respect for each other either and rarely cooperate toward common goals.
	For the purpose of game effects, a chaotic evil creature is also considered evil.

resistances.name: Melee and Ranged
resistances.details: Half damage from melee and ranged attacks

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Swarm Attack
traits.details: an enemy that starts its turn within the aura takes 5 damage.

traits.name: Swarm Grab
traits.details: The wretched tide does not need to spend a minor action to sustain a grab, and if the wretched tide moves away from a creature that it has grabbed, the grab does not end unless the wretched tide is no longer adjacent to the grabbed creature.

auras.name: Swarm Attack
auras.details: an enemy that starts its turn within the aura takes 5 damage.

powers.range: Targets a creature that is not grabbed by the wretched tide

attacks.name: Hit
attacks.range: Targets a creature that is not grabbed by the wretched tide

hit.description: damage, and the target is grabbed. A creature grabbed by the wretched tide cannot make opportunity attacks against it

powers.name: Engulf
powers.requirements: must not have a creature restrained
powers.range: Targets a creature grabbed by the wretched tide

attacks.name: Hit
attacks.range: Targets a creature grabbed by the wretched tide

hit.description: the target is pulled into the center square of the wretched tide’s space and takes ongoing 10 damage and is restrained (save ends both). While the target is restrained, it remains at the center of the wretched tide’s space when the swarm moves, it cannot make opportunity attacks, and the target doesn’t have line of sight or line of effect to anything other than the swarm. When the target saves, it slides to a square of its choice that is adjacent to the swarm

powers.name: Vile Death
powers.trigger: when the wretch tide drops to 0 hit points

effect.description: The wretched tide gains one extra minor action per turn.
